reader_summary.headline: I’m Zack Fuss and today we’re breaking down NextEra Energy.
reader_summary.overview: I’m Zack Fuss and today we’re breaking down NextEra Energy. NextEra is America’s most valuable energy firm and consists primarily of two businesses. To help break down the business, I’m joined by Mark Tomasovic, an investor at Energize VC.

key_points.text: NextEra is America’s most valuable energy firm and consists primarily of two businesses.
In our conversation, we discuss the structure of the energy market, what’s changed in the renewables space over the past twenty years.
Please enjoy this breakdown of NextEra Energy.
